title: RNA Extraction Using TRIzol
author: Jadranka Nappi
materials: cDNA synthesis – Protoscript II (NEB #E650S) 1. In a 0.2mL PCR tube, add 6µL RNA and 2µL random hexamer mix 2. Incubate 65°C for 5 minutes (PCR machine) 3. Add 10µL reaction mix, 2µL enzyme mix. 4. Incubate (PCR machine) which entails:25°C – 5 minutes42°C – 60 minutes80°C – 5 minutes 5. Clean for 16S PCR or just dilute before 16S PCR.

steps.title: Homogenize Sample
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt the sample to release nucleic acids.

substeps.instruction: Cut sample into sections and grind with a sterile pestle in a 1.5mL tube
Add 100uL of MG water
Split the sample evenly into two 1.5mL tubes using a wide-orifice or cut pipette tip (~50uL each)
Place one tube in -20C storage for later PowerSoil extraction (DNA Only)

steps.title: Lysis and Bead Beating
steps.instruction: Lyse the remaining sample using TRIzol and mechanical bead beating in a fumehood.

substeps.instruction: Rinse the remaining tube with 500uL TRIzol and transfer into a lysis bead tube (Lysing Matrix E MP Bio)
Add the remaining 500uL TRIzol into the lysis tube
Bead beat using a Tissue lyser: 4x 30 sec cycles with 30 sec pauses at maximum speed

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Separate the mixture into aqueous, interphase, and organic phases using chloroform.

substeps.instruction: Transfer contents from the lysis tube to a 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube, avoiding the beads
Vortex for 30s, rest for 30s, and vortex again
Incubate at RT for 5 min (alternatively, samples may be frozen at -20°C)
Add 200 µl of room temperature chloroform and mix by inverting the tube several times
Incubate at RT for 2-3 min
Centrifuge for 15 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4°C
Transfer the upper aqueous phase containing the RNA to a new tube

steps.title: RNA Precipitation
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the RNA from the aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µl of glycogen (20 µg/µl; 20 µg added) to the upper aqueous phase
Add 600 µl of cold isopropanol and mix by inversion
Incubate for 10 min at RT
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 12,000 × g at 4°C
Discard the supernatant with a pipette
Add 1000 µl of 75% ethanol
Mix by gently tapping and inverting the tube to clean the tube wall
Spin at 12,000 xg for 5 min at 4°C
Repeat the wash step (ethanol addition and spin)
Discard the supernatant with a pipette
Dry the pellets by leaving tubes open at 37°C in an oven for up to 20 min
Add 30 µl of RNase-free water
Incubate at 55°C for 5-10 min, tapping the tubes during the process

steps.title: DNase Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove DNA contamination from the RNA samples.

substeps.instruction: For each reaction, add a master mix of Dnase/buffer/water (10µl per sample)
Mix gently by pipetting (do not vortex; spin briefly if necessary)
Incubate at 37°C for 30 min
Inactivate DNase I by adding 4 µl of Stop Solution, mix gently, and incubate at 65°C for 10 min (total volume 44µL)
Store RNA samples at -80°C if not proceeding immediately to the next step

steps.title: RNA Re-purification
steps.instruction: Perform a secondary purification of the RNA (do not add reagents as a master mix).

substeps.instruction: Add 4µl of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2, ice cold) and mix well by tapping
Add 1 µl of glycogen (20 µg/µl; 20 µg added) if low yield is expected (total volume 49uL)
Add 50 µl of ice-cold isopropanol and mix well by tapping
Incubate samples at -80°C for at least 1h (or -20°C overnight)
Spin at 12,000 xg for 10 min at 4°C
Remove supernatant with a pipette
Add 1000 µl of 75% ethanol
Mix by gently tapping and inverting the tube to clean the tube wall
Spin at 12,000 xg for 5 min at 4°C
Repeat the washing step
Dry the pellets by leaving tubes open at 37°C
Add 20 µl of MG water
Incubate at 55°C for 5-10 min
Check RNA concentration using Qubit and quality on gel and Nanodrop (aliquot 5uL)
Store RNA samples at -80°C
